neighbours.label: the slot just before a season or holiday word in friendly wishes and seasonal tips ('enjoy your [summer]', 'beat the [summer] heat')
fire: Wishing all our readers a relaxing summer break by the sea!
Here are five easy ways to stay cool during the hot summer months.
We hope all of you have a lovely holiday season with your families.
Thanks for reading, and enjoy the rest of your summer!
These light salads are perfect for the warm spring evenings ahead.
Stock up on blankets before the cold winter nights arrive.
Happy Friday, everyone, and have a great weekend!
Our shop will be closed for the Christmas holidays from Monday.
quiet: Wishing all our readers good luck with their new business plans.
Here are five easy ways to stay organised during a busy move.
We hope all of you find the new software easy to install.
Thanks for reading, and leave your questions in the comments!
These light salads are perfect for a quick lunch at the office.
Stock up on batteries before the new camera arrives.
Thanks again, everyone, for the helpful feedback on the draft.
Our shop will be closed for repairs to the roof from Monday.

notes: Card: determiners and 'long [gone]' in summer contexts; + pole output suppresses ' summer', ' winter', ' holiday', ' evening', so the - pole promotes them. Probe: 'enjoying their summer' 0.79 at ' their', 'beat the summer heat' 0.41, 'have a wonderful day' 0.51, 'fix the leak' 0.03.
